info.text:
Roommate moves out? You could owe the whole rent.
Many shared leases make tenants "jointly and severally liable": each signer can owe the full rent (Nolo).
Our math: $2,000 rent split two ways is $1,000 each. If one stops paying, the landlord can ask the other for $2,000.
A roommate side deal doesn't change what you owe the landlord, and the deposit usually stays until everyone moves out.
US median gross rent (rent plus utilities): $1,191 in 2021, $1,557 in 2025 (Census ACS 1-year). Laws vary by state and lease.
Sources: Nolo; FindLaw; US Census Bureau American Community Survey.
News and education, not financial advice.
